reviews.text: I went to get my 7 day free trial like the app offered but it charged my account 60$ instead!! This is so misleading and so scammy. Don’t use this app unless you want unnecessary charges to your card. 😡

reviews.title: Some good features but unreliable and buggy
reviews.text:
The app is okay, but some useful features are either missing or behind a paywall. For example, I’d like to have more than one shopping list for different stores. I don’t mind paying for an app that works well, but $5 a month is ridiculous when basic features are still very buggy.

I briefly used Cooklist a few years ago and decided to try it again because I’m moving. Now I remember why I deleted it. Before starting fresh, I deleted all my old pantry items. I currently only have about 20 items, yet several recipes tell me I already have ingredients that are definitely not in my pantry. These appear to be leftover items from when I first used the app, even though I’m sure I deleted them because they don’t appear in my pantry list on the app. 

The whole point of tracking my pantry is to reliably see what I can make and what I need to buy. If the recipe feature is still counting ingredients I deleted, I can’t trust it. I’d consider paying developers if they did their jobs, but considering the basic features  don’t work, I will not be doing that.

reviews.title: Constant outages
reviews.text: The app is constantly having outage issues with store connections. When you reach out to customer service to inquire about downtime or resolution. You get told that they’re short-staffed and there’s no update on when the functions will be back. When you cook a recipe, it’s supposed to pull the ingredients that you utilize out of your pantry for you to update; however, it doesn’t actually pull those ingredients. It pulls ingredients at random. This app has serious flaws, and it doesn’t seem like customer service cares to address any of them.

reviews.title: Not worth your time
reviews.text: Says it will save you time and money, but it requires you to spend an hour scanning the barcodes of everything in your fridge and pantry just to give you very bland recipes, or recipes that require you to substitute a bunch of stuff that the recipe doesn’t call for so it would just turn out weird anyways. $59.99 for the year is outrageous when it basically suggests grilled chicken 12 very similar ways.

reviews.title: Glitchy and slow
reviews.text: App has been glitchy and slow since I first started using it. Has a lot of bugs that need to be worked out. It still can’t link to my main grocery store (Albertsons) and it takes forever to sync to my local target. Pretty unacceptable since I’m paying for the advanced features.

reviews.title: Good concept ruined by bugs and greed
reviews.text: When I first heard about Cooklist, I thought it sounded great: being able to keep track of your pantry, find recipes, make a weekly list, and then place your order directly with your local grocery store. I was just starting to cook so it was an extremely helpful tool for a while. We were using it so often we upgraded and got a subscription. But as time went on, various bits of functionality stopped working correctly and for the last two years the app has not worked correctly with Kroger stores, which is the primary set of stores we use. This meant that we could no longer transfer our shopping list to the store app, and our pantry stopped being updatable because it required a receipt from the store and the interface was no longer working. After years of it not working correctly we decided to cancel our subscription and go back to just the regular service. Apparently, in that time they have changed the functionality even more so now the app is almost useless if you don’t have a subscription. I have subscriptions for lots of things and I’m more than willing to spend the money if the product is worth it, but you are now forcing people into a monthly subscription for a broken product that doesn’t even provide half of the features that you use for marketing the product. At this point, I don’t think we would stay or come back even if you do get that functionality working again due to how bad of an experience this has been. reviews.title: Who’s rating this?!
reviews.text: This is the worst meal prep subscription I’ve used! The pantry entry is decent enough but the meals are terrible. It feels like they have a bot scrapping the internet for recipes then doing a horrible time transferring the ingredients and instructions to their format. The first three meals I tried to cook, all highly rated, had ingredients in the steps that weren’t in the list so I didn’t shop for them. The alternative suggestions were ok but skipped very obvious ones I had. Example I needed black pepper powder and it suggested lemon pepper when I had fine ground black pepper in the app’s pantry. If this is all you used I suggest try any other similar app so you can gauge for yourself. I have 5 others I would recommend before this one.

reviews.title: Amazon and Instagram Import does not work
reviews.text: Why am I paying for your app if half of your features that you advertise do not work? My Amazon has not been connecting to my app for the past 3 months. I also keep getting errors for when I import from Instagram. You say that your team is working on it and that you’re hoping to hire new people to help fix your issues, but your lack of staffing and developers is not my problem. If I am paying for the services that you say that you have, then they should be working.

reviews.title: Poor Design
reviews.text: Forcing users to answer unnecessary questions with slow transitions is always an instant turn off. When will incompetent devs learn most users don’t care about what they think the app should be used for? Give an option to skip, I’ve downloaded the app, you don’t need to ask me guided questions to appeal features I already know about.

reviews.title: Canceling
reviews.text: This has been an absolutely life changing up until recently. I’ve been able to plan meals and keep track of my pantry inventory like a pro! Making a meal plan and then having the shopping list exported to my Walmart app shopping list has been wonderful. Buuuutttt now my shopping list no longer syncs with my Walmart app. If this doesn’t change I will be canceling my subscription when the renewal happens in may. I’m not the only one to have this problem. I’ve seen posts of people who have been having the same problem for months with no end in sight. Please please fix this Cooklist!!!

It doesn’t have an option to browse online, you HAVE to get the app, which I would have been fine with doing if I needed to to actually purchase. It took forever to set up an account just for me to search the same product and it not even be available. Complete waste of time. I feel like they are fishing for users by listing groceries available for cheaper that aren’t even available.

reviews.title: Kroger
reviews.text: I used to love this app. I loved it so much that I didn’t mind paying the yearly subscription price. It uploaded all of my purchases and it also helped me cut down wasted food AND helped me “shop” from my cabinet. This app hands down saved me so much money on my grocery bill. Then all of a sudden, Kroger doesn’t link. Hasn’t linked for a year, January 15, 2025 was the last trip it registered in my history.  I am sorry but this is the major grocer in my area with the next option being Walmart, which in my area is not where I would ever go to get any fresh foods/produce. You lost my subscription because of this. Please fix this so that Kroger links. I really miss this app a lot and I do pick-up orders at Kroger, which means no physical receipts… which I also just don’t have time to scan in, individually anyways… if they offered physical receipts.

When selecting to use only items in my pantry, it would include recipes that had items that were not in my pantry.  Some of the directions seem to be out of order on the recipes as well.  If you have to go to the website that has the recipe on it, you have to close so many ads just to see the recipe.  I understand that isn’t the apps issue, but it just added to the frustration when trying to use the app.  I cancelled before the end of my trial due to the errors and frustrations.
